name: React Flow
summary: MIT-licensed React library for building node-based UIs: flowcharts, diagrams, workflow and no-code editors.
description: A customizable React component for interactive node-based editors and diagrams: dragging, zooming, panning, selecting, sub-flows and custom nodes and edges are built in, alongside Background, MiniMap, Controls, Panel, NodeToolbar and NodeResizer components. Ships with docs, an example library and a set of shadcn UI components; Pro adds advanced examples, prioritized bug reports and 1:1 support.
contains: builds flowcharts, diagrams, workflow builders, no-code apps and visualizers
built-in: drag, zoom, pan, multi-select, sub-flows, custom nodes and edges
components: Background (lines/dots/cross), MiniMap, Controls, Panel, NodeToolbar, NodeResizer
38.6K GitHub stars, 16.34M weekly installs; the repo covers React Flow and Svelte Flow
MIT library; React Flow Pro subscription for advanced examples and support
